body:
Founder, playing the real live client/server, reported the Living Map wasn't actually visible/working: 'no all cap win con - im not seeing frontier village ... i dont see a hex grid.' Root cause: Phases 1-2's real, tested systems were never connected to a running match. New living_map_bridge.h/.c founds a real, live HexGrid/TownRegistry/CreepRegistry per match (2 towns per side, 2 neutral, 3 cows), ticks and checks the real win condition every arena_update/arena_update_teams tick. Found and fixed a real naming collision (arena_game.c's own creep_spawn vs packages/livingmap's) by renaming to living_map_creep_spawn. New PACKET_ARENA_SNAPSHOT_LIVING_MAP wire packet; apps/arena's minimap now shows real town/creep markers. Live-verified: a real fast-forwarded server + 2 real bots completed a full match with the new wiring active, zero crashes. 5 new tests, full suite green (3169 assertions). Not done: hex-grid outline rendering, a real capture-node/militia-boost card wiring (so the live win condition, though real, is currently unreachable in a match), and the G-key card-UI panel redesign. ECOWAR commit d56f24e.

⚓ ☃
title: Living Map Phase 7: real arena<->living-map wiring into the actual live client and server
